queries.sql: SELECT `ta`.`id`, `ta`.`nama_tahun`, `ta`.`semester`, `ta`.`status_aktif`, `ta`.`deleted_at`, `ta`.`created_at`, `ta`.`updated_at`, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kelas k WHERE k.id_tahun = ta.id AND k.deleted_at IS NULL) AS jumlah_kelas, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM anggota_kelas ak WHERE ak.id_tahun = ta.id) AS jumlah_anggota, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jadwal_guru jg WHERE jg.id_tahun = ta.id) AS jumlah_jadwal FROM `tahun_ajaran` `ta` WHERE `ta`.`deleted_at` IS NULL ORDER BY `ta`.`nama_tahun` DESC, FIELD(ta.semester, 'Ganjil', 'Genap')
